第003章 让我杀
十里远之处,一名年约十八的少女穿梭在巨树之间,女子身法飘逸精妙,身子巧妙地躲过了周围的树枝。女子的速度更是惊人,从远处看只能看到一个身影一闪而过。
这时,女子停下脚步,静静地看着前方,“刚才好像有人在叫。”女子低声自语,然后闭上双眸施放出了灵识,顿时,方圆十里的景物都清晰的浮现在了她的脑海之中。
“咦？虚境三阶灵兽,嗜灵兽。哦?还有一个凡人,好奇怪的衣服,难道是外域人?”女子心中一动，随即身影一闪便消失在了原地。
灵兽也就是嗜灵兽一个闪身便挡在了岳雨面前,他跑了半天早已筋疲力尽了,此刻一点力气也没有了,腿一软便坐在了地上。“穿越穿的没面子也就算了,现在难道又要死了吗?”看着嗜灵兽朝着自己走来,岳雨有些不甘。
嗜灵兽眼神之中寒光闪烁,作为嗜血的灵兽,死在它爪下的人类多不胜数,眼前这个弱小的人类待会就是自己的腹中之食了。
看着嗜灵兽挥舞着双爪扑来,岳雨不甘的闭上了双眼。
咻!!!一道蓝色光芒划过,直直向嗜灵兽的脑袋袭去。嗜灵兽身为虚境灵兽实力也不弱,身子一闪便险险躲了过去。
嗜灵兽落地,警惕的看着四周,眼神之中充满凝重之色,显然刚才的攻击不弱。
岳雨睁开双眼,一脸惊喜的看着四周,因为刚才在他脑海中响起了一个声音,声如莺啼般悦耳。“你退后,我来对付它。”
岳雨费力地站起身,然后躲向了远处,嗜灵兽也并没有理会他。
随后,一道婀娜的身影缓缓落下,岳雨只是看了一眼,便被她的美丽迷住了。
一袭紧身的青衣将少女那身材完美的勾勒出来,修长的双腿笔直圆滚,柳腰不堪一握,胸前那高耸的双峰更是异常饱满。她的面容更是美丽,精致的面庞如玉般的白嫩,没有一点瑕疵,红嫩的嘴唇,高挺的鼻梁,美眸散发着点点蓝光，就犹如仙女一般。
双脚轻轻点地,随即素手轻抬,食指与中指并拢,一道蓝色的剑气形成,玉指朝着嗜灵兽轻轻一点,蓝色剑气便迸射而出。
感受着那袭来得恐怖剑气,嗜灵兽不敢大意,集中灵念,双眼之中绿光闪烁,瞳孔瞬间变大,一股无色的气流从它的眼睛之中迸射而出,同时双爪之上绿芒闪烁,双爪一挥,两道绿芒撞向了袭来的剑气。
女子狡黠一笑,双眸之中蓝色光芒闪耀,轻喝一声,便跃到了上空,一柄通体散发着蓝光的长剑已然握在了她的手中。
剑身轻颤,隐约发出一阵吼叫之声。此时,嗜灵兽眼中充满恐惧之色,身体微微颤抖。
少女右手臂上蓝光缭绕,同时蓝光还不断向剑身处汇聚。
霹雳啪啦!
剑身之上蓝色的电流高速流转,雷霆之威的恐怖气息让嗜灵兽充满绝望,它此刻才知道对方的实力不是自己可以抗衡的。

远处的岳雨感受到那恐怖的雷电气息,心里也是一阵发寒,看着少女一脸的崇拜与羡慕,“待会一定要拜她为师,太帅了。”岳雨在心中下定了决心，浓烈的期待感油然而生。
“惊雷剑决第一式:雷霆怒斩!”伴随着少女一声轻喝,一道月牙状的雷电犹如流星一般划破长空,直直的向那嗜灵兽的头颅劈去。感受着一股死亡的气息,嗜灵兽急忙运转全身灵力,周围红色的气流如潮水般不断向它的口中汇聚。人人都怕死,灵兽也是如此,此刻,它施展出了自己最强的一击,希望能够抵挡住那恐怖的攻击。
巨口一张,比之前大了十倍的红色巨球飞出,朝着那袭来的雷电奔去。
嘶!嘶!两者碰撞,红球瞬间便被击散,雷电的威力丝毫不减,嗜灵兽眼中充满震惊绝望。
它原本以为自己的攻击能挡下对方的攻击,可是竟然轻易的便被击散。显然,它还是低估了少女的实力,红色巨求威力足矣轰碎一块巨石,但和刚才的雷电相比,它就仿若一张纸,而雷电则是一把锋利的剑,两者的差距不言而喻。
嗷!雷电无情的劈在了嗜灵兽的头上,一声惨叫后,嗜灵兽便倒了下去。
看着少女，岳雨心中很是震惊，看起来柔弱无骨的美丽少女，竟然如此的强大，美女高手啊。
再看着地上那被电的发焦的嗜灵兽,岳雨心中一阵畅快。少女玉足轻点,便到了那嗜灵兽身前,看着它并未死去,少女微微一惊,不过它也是奄奄一息,命不久矣。“不愧是虚无境灵兽。”少女轻叹一声便准备结束它的生命。
“美女等下。”见少女准备动手,岳雨急忙开口。
“恩?怎么?”少女转身看着岳雨问道。
被如此美丽且厉害的美女盯着,岳雨有些不自然,“咳,美女,能不能......让我杀?”刚才嗜灵兽可是让岳雨吃了不少苦头,此刻他想亲手宰了嗜灵兽,以泄心头之恨。
“好吧。”少女应道,随后给了岳雨一柄匕首。
握着匕首,岳雨走到嗜灵兽面前,微微一笑,“小猫,死在我的手里是你的光荣。”嗜灵兽若能听懂,必定大骂,死在你一个普通人的手里光荣个屁!我宁愿被那女的杀死。
岳雨此刻有些紧张,握着匕首迟迟没有下手,毕竟他以前连只鱼都没杀过,此刻要杀嗜灵兽,还是有些不忍。
“还是我来吧。”少女轻声说道。
“不,我来。”岳雨呼了口气,向身后退了几步,想着,不就是只猫吗,心一狠,如扔飞标一般,匕首便飞向了嗜灵兽。噗嗤!嗜灵兽很悲剧,因为匕首不偏不斜的刺进了它的屁股内,它身子微微一颤,便死去了,爆菊而亡。
叮！你杀死了虚无境三阶嗜灵兽，获得经验一千五。
叮!被杀死的生物灭杀人类三十五人,你将其击杀做了善事,获得经验值五百。
叮!由于你经验值达两千,你能提升五级,是否升级?。
一连串悦耳的声音响起,岳雨有些懵了。“这,谁在说话?”岳雨看了看左右除了他只有那少女了。

“怎么了?”少女见岳雨神色有些不对便问道。
“哦,哦,没事。”岳雨平复下心中的疑惑,故作镇定的说道。
少女也并未在意,心中却想着,“师父说我这次外出会碰到贵人,难道就是他?”看了岳雨一眼心中也是不确定,因为她感受不到岳雨体内有一丝灵气,就是连灵属性都没有,显然是一个无法修炼的普通人。
此刻岳雨心中却微微有些激动,“游戏系统?”以前在小说中一些主角穿越后获得逆天的游戏系统,从此成为逆天的存在,岳雨觉得自己或许也是如此！
“是。”岳雨默声应道。
恭喜你的等级达到五级,获得二十五点属性,五个技能,是否查看并使用?
“是!”岳雨没有多想便应道,同时心中越发激动。
随后在岳雨的脑海中浮现出了一个图像,长期玩网游的他也对这图像并不陌生,正是一个技能栏。

Chapter 003 Let me kill
Ten miles away, a girl about eighteen years old shuttled between the giant trees. The woman's movements were elegant and exquisite, and her body skillfully avoided the surrounding branches. The woman's speed was even more astonishing. From a distance, she could only see a figure flashing by.
At this time, the woman stopped and looked ahead quietly, "It seemed like someone was shouting just now." The woman whispered to herself, then closed her eyes and activated her spiritual consciousness. Suddenly, the scenery within a ten-mile radius clearly appeared in her mind.
"Huh? A third-level spiritual beast in the virtual realm, a spiritual beast. Oh? There is also a mortal with strange clothes. Could he be an outsider?" The woman's heart moved, and then she disappeared in a flash.
The spirit beast, also known as the spirit-loving beast, stood in front of Yue Yu in a flash. He had been exhausted after running for a long time. At this moment, he had no strength at all, and sat down on the ground as his legs went weak. "It doesn't matter if you've lost face through time travel, are you going to die again now?" Yue Yu was a little unwilling to see the spirit-loving beast walking towards him.
A cold light flashed in the eyes of the spirit-thirsty beast. As a blood-thirsty spirit beast, countless humans have died under its claws. The weak human in front of it will become his food in the future.
Seeing the spirit-loving beast rushing toward him with waving claws, Yue Yu closed his eyes unwillingly.
Phew!!! A ray of blue light flashed across and struck straight at the head of the spirit-loving beast. As a virtual realm spirit beast, the spirit-loving beast is not weak in strength, and it narrowly dodged in a flash.
The soul-loving beast landed on the ground and looked around warily, its eyes full of solemnity. It was obvious that the attack just now was not weak.
Yue Yu opened his eyes and looked around with surprise, because a voice just sounded in his mind, as sweet as the cry of an oriole. "You stand back and I'll deal with it."
Yue Yu stood up with difficulty, and then hid in the distance, and the spirit-loving beast ignored him.
Then, a graceful figure slowly fell down. Yue Yu just took one look and was fascinated by her beauty.
A tight-fitting green dress perfectly outlines the girl's figure. Her slender legs are straight and round, her waist is hard to hold, and the towering breasts on her chest are extremely plump. Her face is even more beautiful, her delicate face is as white and tender as jade, without any flaws, her red lips, high bridge of nose, and beautiful eyes exude a little blue light, just like a fairy.
He tapped his feet lightly on the ground, then raised his bare hands lightly, and brought his index and middle fingers together to form a blue sword energy. He tapped his jade finger towards the spirit-loving beast, and the blue sword energy burst out.
Feeling the terrifying sword energy that was coming, the spirit-loving beast did not dare to be careless. It focused its spiritual thoughts, the green light in its eyes flashed, and its pupils instantly enlarged. A colorless air burst out from its eyes. At the same time, the green light on its claws flashed. With a wave of its claws, two green lights collided with the incoming sword energy.
The woman smiled slyly, with blue light shining in her eyes. She shouted softly and jumped into the sky. A long sword with blue light all over her body was already in her hand.
The sword trembled slightly, and there was a faint roaring sound. At this time, the spirit-loving beast's eyes were filled with fear and its body was trembling slightly.
The girl's right arm was surrounded by blue light, and at the same time, the blue light continued to converge towards the sword.
Thunderclap!
The blue current on the sword body was flowing at a high speed, and the terrifying aura of the thunder's power filled the spirit-loving beast with despair. It was only at this moment that it realized that the opponent's strength was not something it could contend with.
Yue Yu in the distance felt the terrifying breath of thunder and lightning, and felt a chill in his heart. Seeing the admiration and envy on the girl's face, he said, "I must become her disciple later, she is so handsome." Yue Yu made up his mind in his heart, and a strong sense of expectation arose spontaneously.
"The first style of the Thunder Sword Jue: Thunder Slash!" Following the girl's soft shout, a crescent-shaped thunder and lightning cut through the sky like a meteor, striking straight at the head of the spirit-hungry beast. Feeling the breath of death, the spirit-loving beast hurriedly circulated its spiritual power, the surrounding red airflow continued to converge into its mouth like a tide. Everyone is afraid of death, and so is the spirit beast. At this moment, it unleashed its strongest attack, hoping to withstand the terrifying attack.
He opened his huge mouth, and a giant red ball that was ten times larger than before flew out and ran towards the incoming thunder and lightning.
Hiss! Hiss! The two collided, and the red ball was instantly scattered. The power of the thunder and lightning was not reduced at all. The eyes of the spirit-loving beast were filled with shock and despair.
It originally thought that its own attack could block the opponent's attack, but it was easily defeated. Obviously, it still underestimated the girl's strength. The power of the red giant was enough to smash a boulder, but compared with the thunder and lightning just now, it was like a piece of paper, while the thunder and lightning was a sharp sword. The difference between the two is self-evident.
Ouch! Thunder and lightning struck the soul-loving beast mercilessly on its head. After a scream, the soul-loving beast fell down.
Looking at the girl, Yue Yu was shocked. The beautiful girl who looked weak and boneless was actually so powerful and a master of beauty.
Looking at the soul-loving beast on the ground that was scorched by electricity, Yue Yu felt refreshed. The girl tapped her jade feet lightly and arrived in front of the spirit-loving beast. Seeing that it was not dead, the girl was slightly shocked, but it was also dying and would not live long. "As expected of a void realm spiritual beast." The girl sighed softly and prepared to end its life.
"Beauty, wait a minute." Seeing that the girl was about to take action, Yue Yu hurriedly spoke.
"Huh? What?" The girl turned and looked at Yue Yu and asked.
Being stared at by such a beautiful and powerful beauty, Yue Yu felt a little unnatural, "Hey, beauty, can you... let me kill her?" The spirit-loving beast had caused Yue Yu a lot of suffering just now, and now he wanted to kill the spirit-loving beast with his own hands to vent his hatred.
"Okay." The girl responded, and then gave Yue Yu a dagger.
Holding the dagger, Yue Yu walked up to the spirit-loving beast and smiled slightly, "Kitten, it will be your honor to die in my hands." If the spirit-loving beast could understand, he would definitely curse, dying in the hands of an ordinary person like you is a shame! I would rather be killed by that woman.
Yue Yu was a little nervous at this moment. He held the dagger and hesitated to make a move. After all, he had never killed a fish before, so he still couldn't bear to kill a spirit-hungry beast now.
"I'll do it." The girl said softly.
"No, I'll do it." Yue Yu breathed out and took a few steps back. Thinking, isn't it just a cat? With a cruel heart, she flew the dagger towards the spirit-loving beast like throwing a flying target. Pfft! The spirit-loving beast was very tragic, because the dagger stabbed into its butt without any deviation, its body trembled slightly, and then it died, exploding its anus.
bite! You killed the third-level spirit-loving beast in the Void Realm and gained one thousand and fifty experience points.
Ding! The killed creature killed thirty-five humans. You did a good deed by killing it and gained five hundred experience points.
Ding! Since your experience value reaches 2,000, you can upgrade to five levels. Do you want to upgrade?
A series of pleasant sounds sounded, and Yue Yu was a little confused. "Here, who is talking?" Yue Yu looked around and saw that the only girl besides him was the one on the left and right.
"What's wrong?" The girl asked when she saw something wrong with Yue Yu's expression.
"Oh, oh, it's okay." Yue Yu calmed down the doubts in her heart and said calmly.
The girl didn't pay attention, but thought in her heart, "Master said that I will meet a noble person this time when I go out. Could it be him?" She glanced at Yue Yu and was unsure, because she couldn't feel a trace of spiritual energy in Yue Yu's body, and he didn't even have spiritual attributes. He was obviously an ordinary person who couldn't practice.
At this moment, Yue Yu felt a little excited, "Game system?" In the past, some protagonists in novels obtained heaven-defying game systems after traveling through time, and then became heaven-defying existences. Yue Yu felt that maybe he was the same!
"Yes." Yue Yu responded silently.
Congratulations, you have reached level five. You have gained twenty-five attribute points and five skills. Do you want to check and use them?
"Yes!" Yue Yu said without thinking too much.He responded, and at the same time his heart became more and more excited.
Then an image appeared in Yue Yu's mind. He had been playing online games for a long time and was no stranger to this image. It was a skill bar.
